lia (Atlas): Hi team — onboarding flow for Atlas web app started failing after we flipped the beta flag. Seeing ~30-40 429s per load from the browser SDK during initial render. Anyone seen this pattern?

maria (CS): Hi Lia, can you share the SDK version + whether you're using ephemeral tokens or long-lived keys? Also which region are your users in?

lia (Atlas): SDK v1.4.2, ephemeral tokens minted by our auth service with TTL=15s, EU users (fr-par region). We call `redwood.init()` once per widget; we have 12 widgets per page. Error looks like: `HTTP 429 \"rate limit\" {\"retry_after\": 8}`.

kevin (Eng): 15s TTL + 12 widgets = potential token churn. If each widget independently requests a token or triggers a preflight, edges see a burst. Can you paste the network request headers for one failing call?

lia (Atlas): header dump:
```
:method: POST
:scheme: https
:authority: api.redwood.ai
:content-type: application/json
authorization: Bearer eph_tok_xyz
x-region: fr-par
user-agent: Atlas/1.4.2
```
body is basic embed init. Request-ID on one failure: rz-22111

maria (CS): Two quick safe mitigations we can do now: 1) I can temporarily lift your edge quota for fr-par for 24h while you patch; 2) change token TTL to 60s from your backend so clients reuse token across widgets. Which do you prefer?

lia (Atlas): Please do the temporary lift while we test TTL change. TTL change requires a deploy.

olivia (SRE): I've applied a scoped quota bump for org=atlas, region=fr-par: +30rps for 24h (applied at 3099999000). Also enabled detailed request traces for your org so you can see preflight vs normal requests in Console -> Observability -> Traces.

kevin (Eng): While lift is active, I'd add client-side quick fixes: 1) debounce init across widgets (single init per page using shared promise), 2) add small randomized jitter before init (100-400ms), 3) set SDK config `init_concurrency_limit: 4`. We can ship a tiny patch to your deployed bundle via feature flag.

lia (Atlas): We shipped debounce + shared promise in feature-flagged build. Preliminary test shows 429s reduced ~80%. We'll roll TTL change next deploy.

maria (CS): Note for KB: common root causes are short ephemeral token TTL, per-widget independent preflights, or per-tab multiple tabs. I'll attach recommended patterns: single token per page, server session tokens for heavy loads, and SDK-level `single_preflight` toggle.

kevin (Eng): One more edge case we saw: if the ephemeral token lacks the `embed:read` scope and client retries with different tokens, the edge returns 403 then 429 on retries. Confirm scopes are correct.

lia (Atlas): Confirmed scopes include `embed:read`. No 403s observed.

ops-bot: deploy atlas/frontend@3099999050 succeeded

lia (Atlas): After debounce + TTL bump to 60s + SDK cap, user QA shows error-free first-loads. Thanks all. Could we get KB entry and a short email we can share with Atlas infra?

maria (CS): Creating KB now + drafting an email template for your infra team outlining steps we applied and suggested long-term mitigations. Will post links within 2hrs. :sparkles:

kevin (Eng): Follow-up RFC: SDK should emit `preflight_cache` telemetry when single_preflight used so we can recommend defaults per-segmentation. I'll start the RFC and tag @devex.

lia (Atlas): Great — will wait for KB and RFC. Appreciate the quick support.
